report_title: NOVA Full-Stack Connectivity & Pre-Flight Integration Matrix

connections.boundary: A. Market Event Ingestion -> Event Dispatcher
connections.data_contract_passed: Raw Kafka JSON message with topics 'market.ticks' / 'market.news'
connections.static_source_evidence: scripts/manthan_trading_bot.py:687-701 instantiates MarketDataConsumer(config, dispatcher) and registers handlers.
connections.failure_fallback_behavior: Consumer drops malformed JSON, retries connection with exponential backoff on placeholder or broker disconnection.

connections.data_contract_passed: Dict[str, Any] parsed into canonical MarketBar (ticker, open, high, low, close, volume, source_timestamp, data_quality)
connections.static_source_evidence: scripts/manthan_trading_bot.py:667 dispatcher.subscribe_tick(pipeline.handle_market_tick); pipeline.py:200-260 converts tick into MarketBar with simulated_date fallback.
connections.dynamic_runtime_evidence: 562 unit and integration tests passing; benchmark_decision_latency.py replayed 1,000 observations.
connections.failure_fallback_behavior: Missing or out-of-order ticks are dropped with warning [PIPELINE:DROP_TICK]; data quality flagged as INVALID.

connections.data_contract_passed: Sequence[MarketBar] -> BarFeatures (EMA spread, normalized spread, Kaufman ER, RSI, Parkinson volatility, ATR, volume Z-score)
connections.static_source_evidence: src/nova/models/xgboost_model.py:421 calls self.pipeline.compute_latest(bars) to construct feature vector for ModelPrediction.
connections.failure_fallback_behavior: If history < warmup (30 bars), BarFeatures.is_warmed_up is False, triggering UNAVAILABLE ModelPrediction fallback.
connections.remediation: None required; feature pipeline fully causal and zero-leakage verified.

connections.boundary: B. Feature Pipeline -> XGBoost / GBDT Model
connections.data_contract_passed: Feature array matching config.feature_names -> Native XGBoost Booster DMatrix
connections.static_source_evidence: src/nova/models/xgboost_model.py:456 extracts float features strictly matching self.config.feature_names and invokes native DMatrix.
connections.failure_fallback_behavior: Pure-python GBDT engine (NovaGradientBoostedRegressor) acts as zero-dependency fallback if native library is unavailable.
connections.remediation: Loaded trained compact XGBoost v3 classifier artifact into decision bot.

connections.boundary: C. Predictive Model -> ModelPrediction Contract B
connections.data_contract_passed: Canonical ModelPrediction (DIRECTIONAL_PROBABILITY, value=0.515, confidence, horizon=1, metadata)
connections.failure_fallback_behavior: Emits ModelPrediction with availability_status=UNAVAILABLE if data quality is corrupted or history is insufficient.
connections.remediation: None required; Contract B parity strictly enforced.

connections.static_source_evidence: src/nova/decision/prediction.py:270-330 maps ModelPrediction into PredictionResult for SentinelDecisionEngine.
connections.failure_fallback_behavior: Returns PredictionResult(is_fallback=True, expected_return=0.0, confidence=0.0) on error or low confidence.
connections.remediation: Implemented XGBoostPredictor adapter bridge in src/nova/decision/prediction.py.

connections.data_contract_passed: Sequence[MarketBar] -> RegimeOutput (regime_type, efficiency_ratio, trend_share, ewma_volatility, is_high_volatility)
connections.static_source_evidence: src/nova/regime/transparent_detector.py:376-413 implements detect_regime adapting Kaufman ER, EWMA vol, and EMA spread to RegimeOutput.
connections.failure_fallback_behavior: Fallback to MarketRegimeType.UNKNOWN with equal 50/50 weighting if history is below ER lookback window.
connections.remediation: Added detect_regime adapter method with correct metadata key mappings to TransparentRegimeDetector.

connections.boundary: D/E. Regime Output -> Strategy Weighting in Decision Engine
connections.data_contract_passed: RegimeOutput.trend_share dynamically sets norm_w_trend = trend_share, norm_w_mr = 1.0 - trend_share
connections.static_source_evidence: src/nova/decision/engine.py:215-224 consumes regime_out.trend_share and sets weights when use_regime_weighting=True.
connections.dynamic_runtime_evidence: 1,000-decision latency benchmark confirmed dynamic regime tracking (TRENDING_BULLISH/RANGING/NORMAL).
connections.failure_fallback_behavior: Preserves static configured 50/50 trend/mean-reversion weights on regime detection failure.

connections.data_contract_passed: StrategySignal (strategy_id, direction, raw_score, confidence, expected_gross_return, volatility_estimate)
connections.failure_fallback_behavior: Neutral signal (raw_score=0.0, direction=NEUTRAL) returned during warmup, suppressing premature trading.
connections.remediation: None required; causal point-in-time signal extraction verified.

connections.data_contract_passed: Gross expected return decimal, volatility, position notional, action -> all-in friction bps, break-even bps, net utility
connections.failure_fallback_behavior: Conservative 25 bps all-in friction penalty assumed if friction parameters are unconfigured.
connections.remediation: Enforced official MANTHAN cost model (₹20 flat brokerage, ₹15.34 flat DP charges, 0 bps proportional fee).

connections.boundary: G. Friction Evaluation -> Portfolio Action Selection
connections.data_contract_passed: Expected net edge bps vs min_net_edge_bps hurdle (2.0 bps) -> candidate ActionType (BUY, SELL, HOLD, NO_TRADE)
connections.static_source_evidence: src/nova/decision/engine.py:320-388 filters actions based on expected_utility >= min_net_edge and rebalance_band_fraction.
connections.dynamic_runtime_evidence: test_no_trade_matrix.py (17 tests) proves candidates with net edge < hurdle are vetoed to NO_TRADE.
connections.failure_fallback_behavior: Forces ActionType.NO_TRADE whenever net edge fails to clear friction hurdle.
connections.remediation: None required; economic clearance hurdle strictly enforced.

connections.data_contract_passed: ActionType, proposed_exposure, data_quality, bar_timestamp, drawdown, available_cash, portfolio_value, current_pos, price
connections.static_source_evidence: src/nova/decision/engine.py:408-430 calls risk_gate.evaluate(...) before creating final TradeDecision.
connections.dynamic_runtime_evidence: test_no_trade_matrix.py proves cash exhaustion, drawdown breach, or data corruption vetoes orders.
connections.failure_fallback_behavior: Immediate override of proposed trade to ActionType.NO_TRADE with recorded risk reason codes.
connections.remediation: Eliminated rogue research bypass in scripts/manthan_trading_bot.py; all orders strictly pass risk gate.

connections.static_source_evidence: execution/src/execution/adapter.py:672-730 maps TradeDecision to OrderIntent, computing share quantity via target exposure fraction.
connections.failure_fallback_behavior: If selected_action is NO_TRADE or HOLD, or if computed share quantity <= 0, adapter returns None without sending HTTP order.
connections.remediation: Corrected SELL sizing in ExecutionAdapter line 711 to compute positive shares on position reduction/liquidation.

connections.dynamic_runtime_evidence: test_execution_client.py (18 tests) and test_execution_adapter.py (31 tests) passing.
connections.failure_fallback_behavior: Catches TradingApiError, handles 409 conflict, idempotent retries, records order state as UNCERTAIN or REJECTED.

connections.static_source_evidence: execution/src/execution/adapter.py:657 calls self.ledger.process_execution_event(result) on fill or partial fill.
connections.dynamic_runtime_evidence: test_sell_and_exit_matrix.py::test_06_partial_fill_reconciliation verifies exact position and cash updates.
connections.failure_fallback_behavior: Rejections leave position intact; partial fills credit/debit only filled shares; uncertain orders flagged for reconciliation.
connections.remediation: None required; robust ledger accounting verified.

connections.static_source_evidence: src/nova/decision/pipeline.py:311-314 retrieves updated portfolio_state and passes it to SentinelDecisionEngine.
connections.dynamic_runtime_evidence: test_full_stack_connectivity.py::test_edge_11_and_12 passed; 1,000-decision latency benchmark tracked cash across all trades.

connections.boundary: L. Decision Cycle -> Audit & Latency Ledger
connections.data_contract_passed: Per-decision audit JSON (decision_id, ticker, action, latency_ms, deadline_status, order_result)
